stem.en: A message reads AUG AAA GGC UAA. Kabir writes the chain as methionine, lysine, glycine, and then a fourth bead for UAA. What is the chain?

text.en: Methionine, lysine, glycine, and then it stops. UAA names no bead. Three beads.

feedback.en: Three codons name beads; the fourth is a stop. The chain is three long.

text.en: Two beads, because AUG is only a signal.

feedback.en: AUG is both the start and methionine. The first bead of nearly every fresh chain is methionine, though it is often trimmed off later.

text.en: Three beads, but starting from AAA.

feedback.en: The start codon names a bead. Methionine, lysine, glycine.

explanation.en: AUG starts and counts. Stop codons end and do not count. Everything between is a bead.
